  • Constructor Details

    • SolarSystem

      public SolarSystem(String name, int numberOfStars, double radius, LocalDate registrationDate, int maxPlanets)
      The constructor creates objects, in this case solar system. It receives the following parameters:
      Parameters:
      name - specifies the name of the solar system
      numberOfStars - number of stars has the solar system
      radius - expresses the radius of the solar system
      registrationDate - shows the date the registration was taken
      maxPlanets - shows how many planets has the system solar The setters for the attributes name, numberOfStars, radius, and registrationDate are called from the constructor. The parameter maxPlanets is assigned a constant. An array of planets with a fixed (constant) size is created. The methods setId and incNextId are called from the constructor. numPlanets and sumMoons are counters and are initialised to zero.

      public void setLastPlanetAdded(LocalDate lastPlanetAdded)
      The Planet class has an aggregation relationship with the Solar System class. This method receives the lastPlanetAdded parameter.
      Parameters:
      lastPlanetAdded - shows a date when the last planet was added. This method checks that the lastPlanetAdded attribute is not null.
      Throws:

    • findPlanet

      public int findPlanet(Planet planet)
      Parameters:
      planet - is the planet object. This method checks that the planet received is not null. If the planet is not null, it checks that the added planet is not a duplicate.
      Returns:
      the position of the planet (within the array) if another with the same name has been found, or -1 if the planet is not a duplicate.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if planet is null

    • findFirstEmptySlot

      public int findFirstEmptySlot()
      This method traverses the planets array to find the first null position.
      Returns:
      the null position within the array or -1 if no null position is found in the array.
